signals.title: Dog Breed Parade (Парад на породите)
signals.location: Tsar Simeon Garden, Plovdiv
signals.reason: A free open-air event in the city's central park with dog breed showcases and agility demonstrations that are pure joy for a 4-year-old.
signals.note: Confirmed on plovdiv-online.com and marica.bg for October 3–4, 2026.

signals.title: Puppet Show: What a Crocodile! (Ама че крокодил!)
signals.location: State Puppet Theatre, Plovdiv
signals.reason: An interactive puppet performance featuring live sand animation visuals designed specifically for young preschoolers.
signals.note: Confirmed on pptheatre.com and sofiastage.com for October 3, 2026.

signals.title: Festival of Bread (Празник на хляба)
signals.location: Krustevich village, Hisarya Municipality (~50 min from Plovdiv)
signals.reason: A peaceful village fair celebrating traditional bread-making with children's workshops, fresh baked goods, and open-air folklore music.
signals.note: Confirmed on hisarya.bg and pbnovini.com for October 3, 2026.

signals.title: Autumn Crafts Fair (Есенен панаир на занаятите)
signals.location: Rayko Daskalov St (Little Main Street), Plovdiv
signals.reason: Over 60 craftspeople demonstrating traditional woodworking, pottery, and glasswork along a pedestrian street where a toddler can watch them create.
signals.note: Confirmed on plovdiv.bg and podtepeto.com for October 1–4, 2026.

signals.title: Kapana Fest – Autumn Edition
signals.location: Central Square / Gladstone Street, Plovdiv
signals.reason: A vibrant open-air market with handmade crafts, food stalls, and daytime music in a stroller-friendly pedestrian area.
signals.note: Confirmed on podtepeto.com and marica.bg for October 2–4, 2026.

signals.title: Charity Cross-Voyage (Крос-Воаяж на Гребната база)
signals.location: Rowing Canal (near the Tower), Plovdiv
signals.reason: A relaxed, wide-open community event where families can join by running, walking, or riding scooters and balance bikes along the flat canal path.
signals.note: Confirmed on bnrnews.bg and novini247.com for October 3, 2026.

signals.title: Children's Play: The Story of Cinderella (Историята на Пепеляшка)
signals.location: Boris Hristov House of Culture, Plovdiv
signals.reason: A colorful daytime stage adaptation of the classic fairy tale, timed comfortably for preschoolers before afternoon nap time.
signals.note: Confirmed on domborishristov.bg and marica.bg for October 6, 2026.

signals.title: Puppet Show: Winnie the Pooh (Мечо Пух)
signals.location: State Puppet Theatre, Plovdiv
signals.reason: A classic stage version of A.A. Milne's beloved bear, gentle and engaging for a 4-year-old.
signals.note: Confirmed on pptheatre.com and how2plovdiv.com for October 10, 2026.

signals.title: Gifts of Thrace Regional Fair (Даровете на Тракия)
signals.location: Arapovo Monastery 'Sv. Nedelya', near Asenovgrad (~25 min drive)
signals.reason: An outdoor country fair with regional farm produce, traditional food, and open meadow space next to a historic monastery.
signals.note: Confirmed on festivali.eu for October 9–11, 2026 at Arapovo Monastery.

signals.title: Colors of Autumn Festival (Багрите на есента)
signals.location: Town Center, Hisarya (~45 min from Plovdiv)
signals.reason: A seasonal town festival offering crafts, regional delicacies, and easy walks among the Roman parklands of Hisarya.
signals.note: Could not find a corroborating source confirming this festival on October 10, 2026.

signals.title: Puppet Show: Peter Rabbit (Зайчето Питър)
signals.location: State Puppet Theatre, Plovdiv
signals.reason: A visiting production by the Stara Zagora Puppet Theatre bringing Beatrix Potter's mischievous rabbit to life on stage.
signals.note: Confirmed on pptheatre.com and how2plovdiv.com for October 25, 2026.

signals.title: Aviation Museum Krumovo (Музей на авиацията)
signals.location: Krumovo Airport grounds (~15 min drive from Plovdiv)
signals.reason: Dozens of full-size vintage airplanes and helicopters scattered across flat, open outdoor grounds where a toddler can wander freely.
signals.note: catalog evergreen

signals.title: Byala Reka Ecotrail Hike (Екопътека Бяла река)
signals.location: Near Kalofer (~55 min drive from Plovdiv)
signals.reason: A gentle mountain trail made of sturdy, railed wooden walkways crossing a rushing river, safe and manageable for a 4-year-old.
signals.note: catalog evergreen

signals.title: Station Street Festival 2026
signals.location: Ivan Vazov Street / Central Square, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Open-air urban street festival offering Balkan and alternative live music, food stalls, and vibrant pedestrian atmosphere; non-verbal music experience.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and eventibg.com for October 2–4, 2026.

signals.title: Kapana Fest 2026 (Autumn Edition)
signals.location: Space above Gladstone Street / Central Square, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Popular bi-weekend open-air craft market with artisan stalls, book bazaar, and live music right in the city centre.
signals.note: Confirmed on podtepeto.com and marica.bg for October 2–4 and October 9–11, 2026.

signals.title: GuitArt Festival: Vlatko Stefanovski Trio Live
signals.location: The King's Little Stables (Малките конюшни), Plovdiv
signals.reason: Open-air rock/ethno fusion concert headlined by renowned virtuoso guitarist Vlatko Stefanovski; entirely instrumental.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and podtepeto.com for October 3, 2026.

signals.title: GuitArt Festival: Yamandu Costa Live in Concert
signals.location: Boris Hristov House of Culture, Plovdiv
signals.reason: World-class 7-string Brazilian guitar virtuoso and Latin GRAMMY winner performing a headline festival set; completely instrumental.
signals.note: Confirmed on domborishristov.bg and plovdiv.bg for October 4, 2026.

signals.title: In Jazz: Bobi Valchev Concert
signals.location: Orpheus Summer Cinema, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Evening jazz concert set at the hillside open-air cinema; accessible instrumental music repertoire.
signals.note: Confirmed on impressio.bg and bilet.bg for October 3, 2026 at Orpheus Summer Cinema.

signals.title: Pianist Ivan Donchev: Beethoven Piano Sonatas Cycle
signals.location: AMTII Concert Hall, Academy of Music, Dance and Fine Arts, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Free-admission classical recital featuring virtuosic interpretations of Beethoven piano sonatas; pure instrumental performance.
signals.note: Confirmed on plovdiv.bg and plovdiv-online.com for October 7, 2026.

signals.title: Vasil Stoev: 'Between Light and Shadow' Solo Exhibition
signals.location: 2019 Exhibition Hall, Gladstone St, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Major retrospective solo exhibition by celebrated contemporary Plovdiv painter; visual arts showcase with zero language barrier.
signals.note: Confirmed on plovdiv.bg and sbh.bg for October 6–25, 2026.

signals.title: International Photography Meetings 2026 ('Memory and Identity')
signals.location: Balabanov House, Old Town, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Curated annual contemporary fine-art photography festival featuring international and Bulgarian photographers; purely visual.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and marica.bg for October 16–31, 2026.

signals.title: Low Emission Zone (LEZ) Driving Restrictions Introduced in Central Plovdiv
signals.location: Central Plovdiv (Small Ring / Zone 1)
signals.reason: Seven-month municipal restriction banning older polluting vehicle categories from entering central Plovdiv, with active enforcement underway.
signals.note: Confirmed on bnr.bg and marica.bg as active starting October 1, 2026.

signals.title: Gladstone Street Sidewalk Closure and Bus Stop #263 Suspension at Cinema Kosmos
signals.location: Northern sidewalk of Gladstone St in front of Cinema Kosmos, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Pedestrians must divert to southern sidewalk and bus stop #263 is bypassed due to major square renovation works.
signals.note: Confirmed on marica.bg to have taken place from August 3 to August 28, 2026, so the disruption is already past.

signals.title: Plovdiv Public Transport Real-time Bus Tracking Live in Google Maps
signals.location: Plovdiv citywide
signals.reason: Plovdiv municipal bus schedules and real-time live GPS arrival tracking are fully restored and integrated directly inside Google Maps.
signals.note: Confirmed on mobilebulgaria.com and vplovdiv.com as active in October 2026.

signals.title: Hisarya Mineral Baths & Roman Heritage Day Out
signals.location: Hisarya (~40 min drive from Plovdiv)
signals.reason: Easy weekend spa escape for thermal swimming and ancient Roman fortifications within short driving distance.
signals.note: catalog evergreen
